map.当年入职或离职，年假按剩余日历天数折算。输入入职日期、累计工龄与折算截止日期，自: If someone joins or leaves mid-year, annual leave is prorated by the remaining calendar days. Enter the start date, cumulative service and the proration cut-off date to get the year's entitlement automatically.
map.折算截止日期（当年12/31 或离职日）: Proration cut-off date (31/12 of that year, or the leaving date)
map.📚 深度解析：入职或离职当年年假按剩余日历天数折算: 📚 In-depth analysis: Prorating Annual Leave in the Year of Joining or Leaving
map.3 月入职的新员工，按入职日到年底的日历天数占全年比例折算当年应享年假。: For a new employee who joined in March, the year's entitlement is prorated by the share of calendar days from the start date to year end.
map.当年离职员工，按在职截止日折算，HR 据此结算未休年假工资。: For someone leaving during the year, prorate by the last day in post, and HR uses this to settle pay for untaken annual leave.
map.累计工龄决定档位天数，再乘当年在职天数占比得到可用天数。: Cumulative service sets the band, and multiplying by the share of days in post gives the usable days.
map.3-15 入职、工龄 5 年、截止 12-31: Joined 15 March with 5 years of service, cut-off 31 December
map.档位 5 天；在职天数 = 365−74+1 = 292（含入职与截止当日）；折: Band 5 days; days in post = 365−74+1 = 292 (start and cut-off days included); prorated = 292/365×5 = 4.00 → rounded down to the nearest 0.5 day, so 4 days.
map.11-01 离职、工龄 12 年: Left on 1 November with 12 years of service
map.档位 10 天；在职天数 = 305；折算 = 305/365×10 ≈ 8.3: Band 10 days; days in post = 305; prorated = 305/365×10 ≈ 8.36 → rounded to 8 days.
map.折算不足 1 天怎么处理？: How is a fraction under 1 day handled?
map.法定口径为折算后不足 1 整天的部分不享受年休假；本页按 0.5 天最小单位取整: By law, any fraction under one full day is not granted. This page rounds to the nearest 0.5 day; without a more generous company policy, round down to whole days instead. The statutory denominator is a fixed 365 days, not 366 in leap years.
map.闰年会多算吗？: Does a leap year change the calculation?
map.不会。法定折算分母固定 365 天，不因闰年改为 366；分子按真实在职日历天数: No. The statutory denominator is a fixed 365 days and does not become 366 in a leap year; the numerator uses the real calendar days in post, so the extra leap-year day only slightly raises the share.
map.工龄 1–9 年 5 天、10–19 年 10 天、≥20 年 15 天: 1-9 years of service gives 5 days, 10-19 years gives 10 days, 20 or more gives 15 days
map.当年入职/离职按剩余日历天数比例折算；本页按 0.5 天最小单位取整，法定口径为: Mid-year joiners and leavers are prorated by the share of remaining calendar days; this page rounds to 0.5 day, while the statutory rule grants nothing under one full day (a company policy may be more generous)
map.折算 = 基数 × 当年在职天数 ÷ 365（法规固定 365 天，闰年不按 3: Prorated = base × days in post ÷ 365 (the law fixes 365 days; leap years do not use 366)
map.按《职工带薪年休假条例》：累计工龄 1–9 年 5 天、10–19 年 10 天: Under the Regulations on Paid Annual Leave for Employees: 1-9 years of service gives 5 days, 10-19 years gives 10 days, 20 or more gives 15 days. Prorated = base × days in post ÷ 365 (fixed by law, not 366 in leap years); this page rounds to 0.5 day, while the statutory rule grants nothing under one full day (a company policy may be more generous). Follow your organisation's policy.
map.结果仅供参考，以《职工带薪年休假条例》与单位制度为准: The result is for reference only; the Regulations on Paid Annual Leave for Employees and your organisation's policy govern.
